name: Coefficient Map to the Directed-Cycle Arrangement Complement
statement: For the oriented bipartite class $C(G)$, the map retaining $d_v=\log(a_{v,1}/a_{v,2})$ is a surjection $\mathcal A(C(G))\to B_G$ with a continuous section, contractible fibers, and a fiber-preserving homotopy to the section. In fact $\mathcal A(C(G))\cong B_G\times\mathbb R^{d_G-|V(G)|}$, so the directed-cycle hypergraph determines its coefficient-space homotopy type.
proof: The graph realization retains both control-ratio coordinates at every vertex. Composing that product with the directed-space arrangement product leaves exactly the displayed difference coordinate and a Euclidean factor.
